errors.generic: Something went wrong. Your data was not touched.
errors.boundaryBody: You can retry or go back Home. Data saved on this device is safe.
errors.dbUnavailable: Cannot open the local database. If you are in private browsing, reopen the app from regular Safari.
errors.fileEmpty: The file is empty or has no recognizable transactions.
errors.fileUnsupported: Unsupported format. Use a CSV or XLSX file.
errors.backupInvalid: This file is not a valid Quadra backup.
errors.backupChecksum: The file was modified or is corrupted (invalid checksum).
errors.backupTooNew: This backup was created by a newer version of Quadra. Update the app.

home.title: This month
home.empty: No transactions yet. Add one or import a file from your bank.
home.noAccountsBody: Start by adding your accounts: name them as you like (bank, card, cash). Then add transactions or import a file.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.confirmDelete: Delete this category? Linked transactions will become uncategorized.

import.title: Import transactions
import.hint: Export transactions from your online banking and pick the file. It is read on this phone and never sent anywhere.
import.skipped_one: {{count}} row ignored (headers, totals or invalid rows)
import.skipped_other: {{count}} rows ignored (headers, totals or invalid rows)
import.willSaveProfile: Format recognized: it will be saved as a profile for future imports.
import.transfers_one: Mark {{count}} transfer between my accounts (excluded from income/expenses)
import.transfers_other: Mark {{count}} transfers between my accounts (excluded from income/expenses)

map.intro: I could not recognize the format. Tell me which columns hold the data: the profile will be saved for next time.
map.splitAmount: Debit and credit in separate columns

tx.applySimilar: Also apply to similar uncategorized transactions
tx.markTransfer: This is a transfer (excluded from income/expenses)
tx.subtitle: Income and expenses of all accounts

rules.title: Automatic rules
rules.intro: Rules assign a category to new transactions. When you fix a category, Quadra creates or updates a rule.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.name: Name
accounts.intro: Add the accounts you want to track (bank, card, cash…). They are used to record transactions and to import bank files.
accounts.hasMovements: This account has {{count}} transactions: delete or move them before removing the account.
accounts.needOneBody: Create at least one account (for example your bank's name): transactions are always recorded and imported on an account.

reports.balancePartialMonth: Current month: the final balance is as of today ({{date}}).
reports.balancePartialYear: Current year: the final balance is as of today ({{date}}).
reports.balanceHint: Includes every movement, transfers too. To make the balance match the real one, set the accounts' starting balance.
reports.customizeHint: Choose what to show and in which order. It applies to this tab and is also saved in backups.

budget.empty: No budgets yet. Set one for a category to keep spending under control.
budget.intro: A budget is a named monthly limit for one or more categories: for example “Home” €900 for Bills and Rent, or “Everything” for all spending. Quadra adds up the spending in those categories and shows what is left.
budget.canExceed: It never blocks anything: you can spend more. When you go over the limit the bar turns red and tells you by how much.
budget.howTo: Tap “New budget”, give it a name, pick the categories and the monthly limit.
budget.savingsIntro: How much do you want to put aside? Set a monthly and/or yearly goal: Quadra takes your income, subtracts spending and tells you where you are.
budget.savingsHint: Leave blank what you don't need. Savings are «income minus spending» for the period; transfers don't count.
budget.savingsNoRoom: with current income there is no room left
budget.pickCategories: Categories (you can pick more than one)
budget.name: Budget name
budget.oneLimitHint: One limit for all the chosen categories. Budgets can overlap (e.g. “Everything” and “Home”).

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.saved: File saved. Keep it in iCloud Drive or Files.

full.title: Full backup
full.never: You have not made any backup yet.
full.hint: Includes transactions, categories, rules, budgets, bank profiles and settings. Save it to iCloud Drive: if you remove the app from the Home Screen, data on the phone is deleted.

restore.title: Restore from file
restore.mergeHint: Merge only adds what is missing. On conflict, the version on this phone is kept.
restore.confirmReplace: All current data will be deleted and replaced by the file content. Continue?

storage.title: Storage on this device
storage.notPersisted: Storage is not persistent: iOS may delete data when space is needed
storage.unsupported: This browser cannot report storage persistence
storage.warning: Warning: removing Quadra from the Home Screen deletes all data unless you have a backup.

never.title: No backup yet
never.body: Create a backup so you never lose your history.

stale.title: Backup is old
stale.body: Your last backup is over 30 days old.

yearEnd.title: Year-end backup
yearEnd.body: Save a full backup before closing the year.

security.title: Privacy & lock
security.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s
security.pinRule: 4 to 8 digits. The PIN stays on this device only and is not included in backups.
security.biometricsUnavailable: Face ID is not available in this browser.
security.confirmRemove: Remove the PIN and Face ID?
security.limits: The lock prevents casual access to the app but does not encrypt data on the phone. No data is ever sent to external servers.

balances.title: My accounts
balances.hint: Enter how much money you have right now on each account. Quadra keeps it updated with the transactions you add or import.
balances.empty: No accounts: add one to see how much money you have.

wealth.title: Net worth
wealth.history: Since the first month on record
wealth.shortHistory: Short history: rough estimate (needs 3 full months with transactions).
wealth.paceHint: Average of the last 3 full months, transfers excluded.
wealth.goalAmount: How much you want to have
wealth.goalTooSoon: Less than a month left: you would need to set aside {{amount}} right now.
wealth.goalReached: You already have that amount: goal reached.
wealth.goalOk: You can do it: with average income of {{income}} you can spend at most {{amount}} a month.
wealth.goalNo: With average income of {{income}} it isn't enough: you would need to spend less than what's required to save {{required}} a month.
wealth.noAccounts: Add an account to see your net worth.
wealth.dashedHint: Dashed: estimate for the coming months at the current pace.

category.emptyPeriod: No transactions in this category in {{period}}.
category.seeAllPeriod: See all transactions in this period

recurrence.title: Recurring
recurrence.intro: Salary, rent, subscriptions: transactions that repeat. When one is due I remind you, or I record it myself.
recurrence.remindHint: If off, it is recorded automatically when due.
recurrence.onlyThis: If you change amount or date, it applies to this time only.
recurrence.name: Name
recurrence.partOf: Part of the recurring “{{title}}”: changes here apply to this transaction only.
recurrence.deleteConfirm: Delete the recurring “{{title}}”? Transactions already recorded stay.

statement.title: Check statement
statement.intro: Upload the PDF statement of an account: Quadra checks the dates and amounts of every line and tells you what doesn't add up. The file stays on your device.
statement.formats: Available reading modes: modo1 and modo2.
statement.unsupported: I can't read this statement format. Please contact the administrator to get it supported.
statement.readError: I can't open this PDF. Make sure it is a statement without a password.
statement.summary: {{account}}, {{from}} to {{to}}: {{statement}} lines in the statement, {{quadra}} transactions in Quadra, {{matched}} match.
statement.wrongAccount: Almost no line matches: are you sure you picked the right account?
statement.readWarning: Reading the PDF doesn't agree with the balances or totals printed on the statement: check by hand too.
statement.sumsDiffer: Difference between Quadra and the statement: {{diff}}. Check the lines below.
statement.missing: In the statement but not in Quadra
statement.missingHint: Spending or income the bank recorded and you didn't: check whether you forgot them.
statement.elsewhere: Found on {{account}}: {{date}} · {{text}} (maybe on the wrong account)
statement.amountDiffHint: Same date and sign, but a different figure: maybe a typo. Below is what you have in Quadra.
statement.notInStatement: In Quadra but not in the statement
statement.notInStatementHint: Transactions the bank doesn't show: check amount, date and that they are on the right account.
statement.pending: From the last few days: it may not be charged yet.
statement.dateDiffHint: Same amount but the date in Quadra is far from the bank's.
statement.bankDate: The bank records it on {{date}} ({{days}} days apart)
statement.okHint: Lines with the same amount and a compatible date.
